drafted_from: tool:read-app-distribution's row in tools/app-release-access/tool-rows.json, read-data/app-distribution.mjs and distribution.mjs, and test/app-distribution.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read which TestFlight routes the app com.example.sample can be installed from right now on release source native-ios, counting only my TestFlight group Members." It reads App Store Connect with the release owner's held key and hands back the short-lived public observation.
no_lists_because: It keeps and reads no list of yours: it takes the app and groups as input and answers one observation without saving it.
instructions: 1. Make sure the release owner's App Store Connect team key is held as app-store-connect-key (key_id, issuer_id, private_key); the tool reads it on a private pipe and never answers it.

2. Say to your AI: "Read the TestFlight routes of com.example.sample on native-ios for the group Members." The AI calls tools:run at @workshop-tools with tool tool:read-app-distribution and source_id, bundle_identifier and testflight_groups. Leave publish out: publish true is refused.

3. Read the observation: source_id, checked_at, expires_at (at most 300 seconds after checked_at) and routes. Each route has state, distribution_state, eligibility_state, reason and, only when ready, an action link on testflight.apple.com or apps.apple.com. Check again after expires_at.

4. A source_id that is not native-ios, a missing bundle_identifier, a tester_email or other extra input, or an app Apple does not resolve to exactly one record is refused with a plain error before or after one Apple read; nothing changes at Apple.

worked_examples.title: One app, one group, a public link that is not yet checked against a device
worked_examples.ask: Read the TestFlight routes of com.example.sample for the group Members.
worked_examples.given: From tools/app-release-access/test/app-distribution.test.mjs (the read answers the safe observation of the one app named): Apple lists one app with bundleId com.example.sample and id app-one; the TestFlight read at 2026-10-08T06:00:00Z reports one public-link route for group g1 and build old, with a tester_email that must not escape.
